about: Pin Drop clues, written for Game Night. Each place has a clue (never naming the place, or a city or country that would give it away), the answer shown at the reveal, its latitude and longitude in degrees, the pack it belongs to (world, usa or canada) and a difficulty (easy, medium or hard). Dealt by dealClues in server/pindrop.js.
